excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, long reddish hair, tanned skin. Wears a light orange tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, red skirt and orange pumps.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_3 angles a cold chisel beneath a heavy layer of greenish-grey silty claystone matrix to free the giant, disk-like vertebrae of a primitive Cymbospondylus ichthyosaur. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
